**Finding: compliant (preferred level).**

§ 22 is the only audit right running against us, and it already sits at our preferred position on every element — annual cap, 30 days' prior written notice, business hours, off-site where practicable, independent auditor bound by confidentiality, Vendor-borne costs unless underpayment exceeds 5%, and an express bar on direct access to Customer systems (plus additional carve-outs for unrelated Customer Data, privileged material and third-party confidential information). § 22.3 adds further protection by treating findings as our Confidential Information. No redline proposed.
